front.title: IPv6 Prefixes Derived from IPN Allocator Identifiers

abstract.t: This document requests an IPv6 /16 prefix for use by IPN Allocators. It defines a method to derive an IPv6 /48 prefix from a 32-bit IPN Allocator Identifier. Use of the derived prefix is optional. The method reuses the existing IPN Allocator registry. It does not encode physical location or define a routing mechanism. The preferred /16 prefix is 5f01::/16. This document also updates RFC 4291 to permit other interface identifier lengths within the allocated block.
